description: This file defines classes and functions for converting PyTorch modules to MKLDNN (Intel Math Kernel Library for Deep Neural Networks) optimized versions, including custom implementations for linear and convolutional layers, batch normalization, and PReLU activation, with serialization support.

classes.name: MkldnnLinear
classes.description: A ScriptModule wrapping a linear layer with MKLDNN optimization, supporting serialization.

classes.name: _MkldnnConvNd
classes.description: Base class for MKLDNN convolution layers (1D, 2D, 3D), handling common attributes and forward pass.

classes.name: MkldnnBatchNorm
classes.description: MKLDNN-optimized Batch Normalization layer for evaluation mode.

methods.name: to_mkldnn
methods.description: Converts a given PyTorch module and its children to MKLDNN-optimized versions based on specified dtype.
